title: Ship: From Brief to Production
description: Taking RemoteCraft's saved-search-alerts feature from a one-line product ask to a deployed feature — scoped, specced, delegated, reviewed, and logged as you go.

title: Defend the Work and Package It
description: Turning the shipped feature into a portfolio artefact and a defensible answer to 'how much of this did you actually build' — plus the estimating and availability habits that keep the next feature sustainable.
